generation_history.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Modular TROUSERS-ONLY piece for Santi Wong. Image1Santi turnaround gives costume shape and palette; image2Captain trousers is isolated delivery workflow/cartoon shading only. Image3Santi barebody defines broad hips/short thick legs. Render ONLY Santi's baggy charcoal blue-grey breeches with thin muted ochre vertical stripes, broad waistband at belly, roomy seat and thighs, gathered leg cuffs just below knees/upperboot. Two legs naturally slightly apart same as basebody, WHITE open gap between legs. Keep short stout proportions, notCaptain longskinny pants. No boots, skin, body, leatherbelt, pouches, apron, scarf or shirt.
Hollow wearable pants with open waist and two open cuff openings, no mannequin plugs. Very simple broad cartoon folds, clean painted stripe pattern consistent allviews, no fabric fibre noise. Front waistband with restrained closure, rear plain with seat seam; sides reflect actual depth. Four exactly coherent orthographic views FRONT LEFT BACK RIGHT, one horizontal row, identical height and cuff baseline, one common camera scale; narrow profiles not magnified. In left/right profiles farleg naturally overlaps near leg, don't change stance. Whole pair contained in each of four invisible cells with very large white separators; allviewgroups complete and no clipping. Pure flat opaque white background, no shadows labels groundline borders or extraelements.

source.postprocessing: Selected generated source copied unchanged; no repainting, axis stretching, rescaling or background editing.

dimension_contract.authority: Provisional art fitting estimates, not owner measurements or reconstructed bounds. 1.70m applies to complete dressed character only.
dimension_contract.same_body: Fit to Santi short stocky body, not Livé slender body.

presentation.camera: Level orthographic elevations intended; illustrated projection limits noted per slot. Head profiles may turn slightly for cavity visibility.
presentation.pose: Natural fixed wearable shape in the body T-pose
presentation.lighting: Soft dimensional painted cartoon shading baked into source; de-light during texturing.
presentation.ownership_and_fit_note: Short baggy striped breeches, same slightly apart leg stance as body, no boots or belt. Maintain stripe continuity and open cuffs.

wearing.note: Short baggy striped breeches, same slightly apart leg stance as body, no boots or belt. Maintain stripe continuity and open cuffs.

validation.method: Visual comparison plus unmodified tools/crop_views.py, modal-background distance tolerance18; own-bounds native cropping.
validation.limitation: Cutter aligns baselines but does not correct the native source height differences, view turns or metre scale. These are source limitations, not a proven physical fit.

pipeline.suggested_crop_command: python tools/crop_views.py art/characters/santi_wong/pieces/trousers/sheet.png --row 0 1 --names front left back right --min-width-ratio 0.1 --size 682 --out art/characters/santi_wong/pieces/trousers/views
pipeline.upscale_note: Extract at native size then apply one common2x LANCZOS upscale to all4 images. Minimum target1062px across set. Upscale adds no source detail.
pipeline.rigging_route: docs/RIGGING.md one donor armature, not independent auto-riggers
